m.chalisa.do1: Bowing my head to Bagalāmukhī, I write this Chālīsā today; be gracious to me always, and may my work be fulfilled.
m.chalisa.cau1: Victory, victory, victory to Śrī Bagalā Mother, the primal Śakti, protector of the whole world.
m.chalisa.cau2: Mother, your face is like a crane's; from this your name became famous.
m.chalisa.cau3: The moon on your forehead and your earrings have a beauty all their own; gods, men and women sing your praise.
m.chalisa.cau4: Yellow garments shine on your body; in your hands are a mallet and a mace.
m.chalisa.cau5: You have three eyes and a garland of campaka flowers at your throat; boundless radiance shines from your forehead.
m.chalisa.cau6: A jewelled throne is resplendent; seeing its beauty, all people are enchanted.
m.chalisa.cau7: Great queen, your seat is yellow; you grant boons to your devotees.
m.chalisa.cau8: Your ornaments are yellow and your sandal paste yellow too; gods, men and nāgas all bow to you.
m.chalisa.cau9: In this way one should hold the meditation in the heart; so say the Vedas, the Purāṇas and the saints.
m.chalisa.cau10: Now I set forth the way of worship, by which sorrow is destroyed.
m.chalisa.cau11: First one should fly a yellow flag, and dress the goddess in yellow garments.
m.chalisa.cau12: Kumkum, unbroken rice, laddus of gram flour, abīr, gulāl, betel nut, sandal paste,
m.chalisa.cau13: garlands, turmeric, fruit and betel leaves: one should offer them all and hold her in meditation in the heart.
m.chalisa.cau14: With incense, a lamp and a camphor wick, one should then perform the āratī with love.
m.chalisa.cau15: One should praise her with both hands joined: Mother, fulfil the wishes of my heart.
m.chalisa.cau16: Mother, devotion to you is the mine of all happiness; be gracious to me, knowing me as your own.
m.chalisa.cau17: Destroy the threefold affliction and all sorrow; dispel the darkness and increase knowledge.
m.chalisa.cau18: Again and again I entreat you: give me unbroken devotion and knowledge.
m.chalisa.cau19: At the end of the worship one should have a fire offering made; that person obtains the fruit the heart desires.
m.chalisa.cau20: Whoever makes an offering of mustard seed into the fire, all that moves and does not move comes under his power.
m.chalisa.cau21: Whoever mixes sesame and rice with milk and has the fire offering made with devotion and love,
m.chalisa.cau22: sorrow and poverty do not touch him; surely all happiness and wealth are his.
m.chalisa.cau23: Whoever offers aśoka flowers into the fire, his home fills with happiness and wealth.
m.chalisa.cau24: Let the fruit of the silk-cotton tree be offered into the fire, and surely all one's enemies waste away.
m.chalisa.cau25: Whoever offers guggul and ghee into the fire, the king comes under his power.
m.chalisa.cau26: Whoever has guggul offered into the fire with sesame, all his bonds are cut.
m.chalisa.cau27: Those who recite the seed-syllables and chant your seed-mantra,
m.chalisa.cau28: who perform the japa at night for one month: all their torments are removed.
m.chalisa.cau29: Where there is a pure spot of ground in the house, there the practitioner should perform the japa.
m.chalisa.cau30: He surely obtains the fruit he wishes; let him have no doubt of this.
m.chalisa.cau31: Or let the practitioner go to the bank of a river and perform the japa with his mind intent.
m.chalisa.cau32: Whoever performs ten thousand japa, all his works are accomplished.
m.chalisa.cau33: Whoever performs the japa a hundred thousand times, his fame spreads far.
m.chalisa.cau34: Whoever repeats your name with his mind intent destroys his enemies in a short time.
m.chalisa.cau35: Whoever repeats the name for seven nights, all his wishes are fulfilled.
m.chalisa.cau36: Whoever performs the japa for nine days, his body becomes free of disease.
m.chalisa.cau37: A childless woman who meditates on you obtains the four fruits, a son and the rest.
m.chalisa.cau38: Meditating morning, evening and noon brings welfare.
m.chalisa.cau39: How far can I tell your glory? Your name is ever auspicious and brings blessing.
m.chalisa.cau40: Whoever recites the Chālīsā daily, Śiva, the lord of Gaurī, is gracious to him.
m.chalisa.do2: I am the son of Santaśaraṇa, Kulapati Miśra by name; I live in the district of Haridvāra, my home the village of Haripura.
m.chalisa.do3: In the year nineteen hundred and ninety-five, in the bright fortnight of the month of Śrāvaṇa, I, the servant of your feet, composed this Chālīsā.
